newsitem.title: POLAND: Hachette in final bid for Polish news-stand chain.
newsitem.headline: Hachette in final bid for Polish news-stand chain.

text.p: The French publishing firm Hachette Distribution services made its final offer to buy Poland's biggest news-stand chain Ruch SA, a treasury ministry spokeswoman said on Tuesday.
"The Hachette offer has been submitted and is currently being reviewed," Maryla Kodym told Reuters, but gave no further details.
A consortium of Hachette and several Polish firms wants to buy a strategic stake in Ruch, which has a 65 percent share in the distribution of press in Poland sold through 17,000 news-stands.
Ruch's net profit in 1995 was 16.2 million zlotys on sale of 2.7 billion zlotys.
